lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon besieged Jerusalem with his entire army, and in Zedekiah's eleventh year the city was breached.
The officials of the king of Babylon entered Jerusalem and sat in the Fish Gate.
Zedekiah fled at night, but the Chaldeans overtook him in the plains of Jericho and brought him to Riblah.
The Chaldeans burned the palace and the houses and broke down the walls, and Nebuzaradan left some poor people vineyards and fields.
Nebuchadnezzar ordered Jeremiah looked after, and he was turned over to Shaphan to be taken home.
